questions.question: Who escapes Azkaban and is Harry's godfather?
questions.note: He was James's best friend. The Ministry thinks he betrayed the Potters. He did not.

questions.question: Who actually betrayed James and Lily to Voldemort?
questions.note: He was the friend trusted with their hiding place. He framed Sirius, faked his death, and hid for twelve years.

questions.question: What is the name of Ron's rat, who is really Peter Pettigrew?
questions.note: He is missing a toe. Hermione's cat Crookshanks keeps trying to catch him because the cat can tell.

questions.question: What kind of creature is Remus Lupin?
questions.note: He transforms at the full moon. Snape brews a potion so he can keep his mind when he changes.

questions.question: What creatures guard Azkaban and feed on happiness?
questions.note: They come to Hogwarts to hunt Sirius. Near them, Harry hears his mother screaming.

questions.question: What form does Harry's Patronus take?
questions.note: He casts it at the lake, thinking it is his father. James's Animagus form was a stag.

questions.question: What phrase makes the Marauder's Map show itself?
questions.answer: I solemnly swear that I am up to no good.
choices: I solemnly swear that I am up to no good.
questions.note: Fred and George give Harry the map. Moony, Wormtail, Padfoot, and Prongs made it.

questions.question: What device lets Hermione relive hours so she can take extra classes?
questions.note: She and Harry use it to save Buckbeak from execution and free Sirius. McGonagall made her promise not to tell anyone.

questions.question: What hippogriff is sentenced to death, then carries Sirius to safety?
questions.note: Draco insults him and gets slashed. The time-turn lets Harry and Hermione free him before the axe falls.

questions.question: What must you do before you approach a hippogriff?
choices: Keep eye contact and walk straight up
questions.note: Hagrid's first Care of Magical Creatures lesson. You wait for the hippogriff to bow back.
